Name: Baal-hanan
Summary: Baal-hanan, the son of Achbor, reigned in Edom after Saul died.
KeyStory: Baal-hanan is the seventh king named in Edom's king list.
RelatedPeople: Achbor; Saul, King of Edom; Hadar, King of Edom
LifeLesson: Kingdoms rise and fall, but God's promise to Israel outlasted every throne of Edom.
